rule: scripts/lib/leaf-alignment.mjs confirmed(): >= 2 of 3 sampled pages with the shown image k != 0 leaves off its source (dHash; thumbnail correlation on ties); or a text (>= 300 prose chars, >= 70% letters) on an image whose stored weight is < 0.25 of its writer median and whose ink share (pixels 15 grey levels under the paper) is < 0.5%; or strongRepeat (containment >= 0.9, sizes within 0.8, >= 50 shingles, no front matter, image dHash >= 20).
note: The repeat and ink thresholds were set on these same two sets; the top-20 spot check of the corpus run (spot-check.json) is the out-of-sample check.
